text: An adjustment to the arrangement with a purchaser of one of Toronto Atmospheric Fund's transactions is recommended whereby Toronto Atmospheric Fund will take more of the risk due to changed circumstances, and both parties will work to maximize recovery.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Adopted the confidential instructions in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (October 18, 2018) from the Vice President, Impact Investing. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (October 18, 2018) from the Vice President, Impact Investing remain confidential in its entirety as it pertains to the security of property belonging to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund; commercial and financial information, supplied in confidence to Toronto Atmospheric Fund, if disclosed, could reasonably be expected to prejudice significantly the competitive position or interfere significantly with the contractual or other negotiations of a person, group of persons, or organization; and a position to be applied to any negotiations carried on or to be carried on by or on behalf of Toronto…
